notes: All literal raw source records/rings/holes and original closed node order retained; no image textures or reference-provider pixels.
Missing building dimensions/materials, unclassified ground materials and small water heights remain explicit model estimates.
Lake Union uses literal OSM ele=5m, datum/time unknown; ocean retains existing 1m game mean-sea estimate, not a tide measurement.
Finite coast render-frame closures create no source road/rail topology joins. Unmodeled source bridges/tunnels/pier decks remain named.
Source cache is exact native geometry with lossless vertex sharing, binary transport and whole-source spatial chunks; no source thinning.

Every original close-up DEM query is preserved; measured surround applies outside. New water cuts/floor queries use the same emitted Float32 faces. Serialization-invalid derived shore fragments are reported separately.

Pike retains the existing source-named Needle hero instead of a second generic tower; source identities retained. SeattleCenter replaces only malformed concatenated relation r20085315 with its two actual source outer components.
No native graphics-quality, target-load, submitted-budget, route or full-parity acceptance is implied by CPU controls.
